deadline.value: Doctoral admission is rolling; the page's fixed dates cover other programs.
deadline.quote: In most graduate programs, Florida Tech admits on a rolling basis.

also.quote: Applications received after the I-20 deadline may not be considered for that entry term.

gre_subject.value: The physics GRE Subject test is recommended but not required (2025-26 catalog entry).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE scores from both the general and subject test in physics are recommended but not required.

supervisor.value: The program page does not state a supervisor-first rule.

funding.value: Assistantships are offered on a competitive basis.
funding.quote: Academic units at Florida Tech may offer graduate student assistantships to full-time, degree-seeking graduate students on a competitive basis.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's entrant follows the master's degree requirements (30 credit hours) first.
entry_route.quote: Students entering the doctoral degree program with a bachelor’s degree must follow the master of science degree requirements listed above for 30 semester credit hours.

gre_general.value: The GRE General test is recommended but not required (2025-26 catalog entry).
gre_general.quote: The GRE scores from both the general and subject test in physics are recommended but not required.

notes: GRE and entry rules come from the archived 2025-26 catalog entry; the current catalog could not be reached. Ocean and space programs are listed separately.
